tasks.label: boot-ios-simulator
tasks.command: xcrun simctl boot 45FF47A0-7D0C-4418-A867-E427176E6EA8 2>/dev/null; open -a Simulator; nohup "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/open_safari_when_ready.sh" > /tmp/home-manager-safari-open.log 2>&1 & echo "Simulator ready — Safari waiter started (log: /tmp/home-manager-safari-open.log)"

tasks.label: open-safari-on-simulator
tasks.command: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0); xcrun simctl openurl booted "http://$IP:8080"
